job.organization: Los Angeles County Office of Education

items.item_text: 01. Listed below are a series of questions regarding your education and experience relating to the position. You must answer the following questionnaire as truthfully and accurately as possible. Your responses to the supplemental questionnaire below may be used in subsequent examination parts to determine your qualifications beyond the minimum qualification requirements for this classification. A few questions will require you to provide examples of related experience, and listing "see resume/application" will NOT qualify as a response and will be considered incomplete, so make sure to answer each question thoroughly. All experience, education, training, and certification must be included in your application in order to be considered. Your responses to these questions are subject to verification and may be assessed in subsequent examination parts. It is important that your responses are true and accurate reflections of your background. Any sign of deliberate misinformation or intentional exaggeration will result in disqualification from this examination process and possible bar from future employment opportunities with the Los Angeles County Office of Education (LACOE). Options: I have read, understood, and agree to the above statements | I have read, understood, and DO NOT agree with the above statements. In selecting this, I voluntarily withdraw from the application process for this position

02. What is your highest level of education? Please Note: Proof of education will be required - you must attach a copy of your diploma or transcript for review. Degrees must be earned from an institution of higher learning recognized by the Council for Higher Education. Foreign degrees and credit units require translation and equivalency established by an agency recognized by the Commission on Teacher Credentialing. Options: No education | High School Diploma or GED equivalent | Some college coursework but no degree | Associate's Degree | Bachelor's Degree | Master's Degree | Doctorate Degree
03. Please list the field in which you obtained your degree. If no degree, list "n/a".

04. How many years of experience do you have in managing business, administrative, and operational services in a social services or early childhood educational organization with multiple funding sources? Options: No Experience | Less than one year of experience | At least one year, but less than two years | At least two years, but less than three years | At least three years, but less than four years | At least four years, but less than five years | Five years or more

05. The next three questions will explore each specific component of required experience listed in Question 4. This position requires experience in managing BUSINESS services in a social services or early childhood educational organization with multiple funding sources. Please describe your experience specifically related to your role in the management of business services in a social services or ECE organization. For each related experience, please include: a) Your job title(s) for each example b) Name of the organization(s) c) Job duties/responsibilities related to the job areas described above d) Funding sources of the described duties/responsibilities e) Length(s) of employment (format: month/year - month/year) If no experience in this area, list "N/A".

06. This position requires experience in managing ADMINISTRATIVE services in a social services or early childhood educational organization with multiple funding sources. Please describe your experience specifically related to your role in the management of administrative services in a social services or ECE organization. For each related experience, please include: a) Your job title(s) for each example b) Name of the organization(s) c) Job duties/responsibilities related to the job areas described above d) Funding sources of the described duties/responsibilities e) Length(s) of employment (format: month/year - month/year) If no experience in this area, list "N/A".

07. This position requires experience in managing OPERATIONAL services in a social services or early childhood educational organization with multiple funding sources. Please describe your experience specifically related to your role in the management of operational services in a social services or ECE organization. For each related experience, please include: a) Your job title(s) for each example b) Name of the organization(s) c) Job duties/responsibilities related to the job areas described above d) Funding sources of the described duties/responsibilities e) Length(s) of employment (format: month/year - month/year) If no experience in this area, list "N/A".

08. How many years of supervisory experience do you have in a Head Start agency? [Supervisory experience includes responsibilities in assigning, scheduling, and monitoring the work of a group. This role has responsibility to hire, evaluate performance, administer disciplinary action, and approving payroll or paid time off.] Options: I do not have any supervisory experience | Less than one year of experience | At least one year, but less than two years | At least two years, but less than three years | Three years or more

09. Please describe your supervisory experience in a Head Start agency. [Supervisory experience includes responsibilities in assigning, scheduling, and monitoring the work of a group. This role has responsibility to hire, evaluate performance, administer disciplinary action, and approving payroll or paid time off.] For EACH related experience, please include: a) Your job title(s) b) Name of the organization(s) c) Job duties/responsibilities related to the job areas described above d) Number and titles of employees supervised e) Length(s) of employment (format: month/year-month/year) If no experience in this area, list "N/A".

10. To what extent have you directed capacity building activities to ensure that appropriate training and support is provided to internal staff and delegate agencies/early childhood education providers? Options: I have no background in this activity | I have training in this, but I have not done it | I have done parts of this under others' direction | I have done this independently, but only occasionally | I have done this as a regular part of my job duties | I have done this extensively and at a high level of complexity

11. Please describe your experience directing capacity building activities to ensure that appropriate training and support is provided to internal staff and delegate agencies/early childhood education providers. For each related experience, please include: a) Your job title(s) b) Name of the organization(s) c) Job duties/responsibilities related to the job areas described above d) Recipients of the capacity building activities e) Length(s) of employment If no experience in this area, list "N/A".

12. To what extent have you overseen grant implementation and project requirements for social service or early childhood educational programs? Options: I have no background in this activity | I have training in this, but I have not done it | I have done parts of this under others' direction | I have done this independently, but only occasionally | I have done this as a regular part of my job duties | I have done this extensively and at a high level of complexity

13. Please describe your experience overseeing grant implementation and project requirements for social service or early childhood educational programs? For EACH related experience, please include: a) Your job title(s) b) Name of the organization(s) c) Job duties/responsibilities related to the job areas described above d) Length(s) of employment If no experience in this area, list "N/A".

14. To what extent have you developed and delivered training programs and technical assistance plans to support school readiness? Options: I have no background in this activity | I have training in this, but I have not done it | I have done parts of this under others' direction | I have done this independently, but only occasionally | I have done this as a regular part of my job duties | I have done this extensively and at a high level of complexity

15. Please describe your experience developing and delivering training programs and technical assistance plans to support school readiness. For each related experience, please include: a) Your job title(s) b) Name of the organization(s) c) Job duties/responsibilities related to the job areas described above d) Length(s) of employment If no experience in this area, list "N/A".

16. The incumbent of this position is required to possess a valid driver's license or the ability to obtain transportation between job sites. Are you willing and able to comply with this requirement? Options: Yes | No
